title: SocialCrawl — Unified Social Media Data API
description: Call any of 357 SocialCrawl endpoints across 44 platforms, run a universal cross-platform social search, trigger a Prism composite, or drive the web-scraping suite — all with your own SocialCrawl API key. Pick a platform and resource, add parameters, and run.

apiKey.title: SocialCrawl API key
apiKey.description: Your SocialCrawl API key (looks like `sc_…`). Get one free — 100 credits, no credit card — at https://www.socialcrawl.dev. Required for 'Run API request' and 'Check credit balance'.

action.title: Action
action.description: What the Actor should do. 'Run API request' is the default. The two 'List…' actions work without an API key and help you discover what's available.
enumTitles: List endpoints for a platform (no key needed)
List pricing for endpoints (no key needed)

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: The platform to query. Choose 'Universal Search' to fan out across many social platforms in one call.

resource.title: Resource (endpoint)
resource.description: The endpoint to call on the chosen platform, e.g. `profile`, `profile/videos`, `video/comments`. For Universal Search use `everywhere`. Not sure? Run with action 'List endpoints' first.

method.title: HTTP method (optional)
method.description: Leave blank for the default — almost every endpoint is GET and resolves automatically. Only set this for the stateful Web Scraping routes that share one resource across several verbs (e.g. `monitors/{monitor_id}` is GET, PATCH, or DELETE). For path-template resources, supply the id (e.g. `job_id`, `monitor_id`, `session_id`) as a normal parameter.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Query parameters as key–value pairs, e.g. {"handle": "charlidamelio"} for a TikTok profile, {"url": "https://..."} for comments, or {"query": "electric cars"} for Universal Search. Values are sent verbatim.

idempotencyKey.title: Idempotency key (optional)
idempotencyKey.description: Optional. An opaque, client-generated string (UUIDv4 recommended). Reusing it within 24h replays the original response and charges 0 new credits — safe for retries.

baseUrl.title: API base URL (optional)
baseUrl.description: Advanced — override the API origin. Defaults to https://www.socialcrawl.dev. Leave blank unless you have a reason to change it.
